original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃及逮捕一家“无证”独立媒体全部新闻编辑室人员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃及内政部称，已逮捕一家事实核查平台的六名工作人员，并指控该平台“无证”且与被禁的穆斯林兄弟会有关联。当局自周一起拘留该独立平台Matsadaash的六名记者，构成其全部团队。该平台称这些记者下落不明，目前尚未对他们提出正式指控。

key_facts.fact: 埃及内政部称逮捕了一家事实核查平台的六名工作人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Egypt's interior ministry said Thursday it arrested six staff members of a fact-checking platform

key_facts.fact: 当局指控该平台“无证”并与被禁的穆斯林兄弟会有关联
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: it accused of being "unlicensed" and linked to the banned Muslim Brotherhood group

key_facts.fact: 当局自周一起拘留该独立平台Matsadaash的六名记者，构成其全部团队
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Authorities detained six journalists from Matsadaash starting on Monday, representing the entire team of the independent platform dedicated to fact-checking

key_facts.fact: 该平台称这些记者下落不明，尚未对他们提出正式指控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The platform said the journalists' whereabouts were unknown. No formal charges have been brought against them
